correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction: annihilator and square force Lie-central z; Leibniz reduces the V-valued bracket to an alternating 3-tensor and central 2-form; both Jacobi terms vanish on an orthogonal basis; GO(B)=K^* O(B), with free shifts killing central terms for nonzero cross parameter; SO(B) transitive on each nonzero norm fiber by Witt's lemma and stabilizer reflections. The resulting q^4 bracket and q+2 orbit counts were independently checked in 3, 5, 7 prime fields by actual standalone path, including full Leibniz rank and special-orthogonal orbit census. Infinite q is covered by the written proof, not experiments.
